facts.value: The central study advising supports you competently with all concerns regarding studying.
The Student Secretariat is your reliable contact point for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your study achievements.
Goethe University accompanies international students with comprehensive advising and services throughout their entire journey from application to graduation.

The PBS offers support and a listening ear for personal concerns. In addition to individual conversations, the PBS provides online lectures and workshops each semester on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couple counseling, there are also group offers.
In addition to a diverse sports program, the university sports also offers courses and videos for stress management and self-assertion as well as events to actively engage and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in starting their careers. Strengthen your career competence through workshops, coaching, and networks. Free of charge, practical, and individualized – your springboard into the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and discrimination-critical environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Counseling in cases of discrimination as well as measures to prevent and reduce discrimination.
The ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding your studies and doctoral process.
The scholarship service supports students and staff from all disciplines. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual consulting!
The Student Services offers affordable housing near the campus. Discover numerous dormitories, get information about rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the Student Services Frankfurt informs about all possibilities of study financing and provides individual consulting.
Stay updated with our newsletter for students, parents, and teachers and on our social media channels where we regularly inform you about the student offerings of Goethe University.
